svg.aria-label: DA-Agent drawn as one bench. A terminal (the browser) is cabled to an intake box (the API), which feeds a card-file cabinet with four drawers (Postgres: jobs, checkpoints, audit log, costs). A carriage on rails (the worker) takes a job card from the open drawer and is cabled to a teleprinter with an antenna (LLMClient, the only part that reaches model providers). At the right end of the rails, an airlock (the runner) takes a lit SQL card through a slot into a sealed glovebox (the sandbox): no cables, one data cartridge clamped down read-only.

g.text: the only way out, to model providers
no network · no secrets · read-only data

svg.text: A question: 1 → 2 → 3 (job queued) → 4 (worker claims it) → 5 (model) and 6 → 7 (SQL), answer back to 1
